input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: explore: find and fix field reads that turn a typed 0 into the example value

doc_friction.issue: says to create the dev branch; the harness had already checked it out, so `git checkout -b` failed once (cost one call)
recent check_*.py scripts (this one included) are wired into no workflow; nothing in the docs a free-choice run reads says whether a new checker should be wired, or how, without a control-plane PR

deviations.why: did not wire the new check into portfolio-validate.yml, because .github/ is CODEOWNERS control plane and would hold this PR for the owner's approval
deviations.did: shipped the check with a unit test that also asserts the ventures tree is clean, and named the wiring as a follow-up in the post and the PR
deviations.result: the venture fixes land now and nothing waits on approval

notes: Explore idea: the zero-clobbering default (`parseFloat(field) || N`). platform/ci/check_zero_default.py found 15 reads on 10 pages. 8 were settings where 0 is meaningful; they now use numOr(), which falls back only on a blank field. 7 count fields got a `zero-default:` comment. Chromium check, typing 0 on each page's example: before the fix the output matched the defaults on all 3 pages; after it, the reconciler's missing commission goes from $915.00 to $1,350.00 at lag 0, the creep checker shows 4 creeping and 0 spikes (was 2 and 1), and the ABA tracker shows 3 of 7 needing attention (was 4). check_js_syntax.py: 11,921 files, 0 failing. node --test pass counts: aba 23, ai-bookkeeper 2710, ai-coding 66, client-rebooking 32, csv-to-sql 46, insurance 42 league-schedule-generator 553, shift-rotation 36, str-turnover 30, supplier-price-creep 27; 0 fail in any.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an engineer auditing 15 reads on 10 pages, fixing 8, writing a checker with tests and a browser check

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
